description: This Java class defines a rule node for transforming messages into email messages within the Thingsboard rule engine. It includes configuration handling, message conversion, and message transformation logic.

classes.name: TbMsgToEmailNode
classes.description: A rule node class that converts messages into email messages for the Thingsboard rule engine.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the node with configuration, determining if the mail body type is dynamic.

methods.name: onMsg
methods.description: Handles incoming messages, converts them to email format, and forwards them.

methods.name: buildEmailMsg
methods.description: Builds a new message containing the email data, ready to be sent.

methods.name: convert
methods.description: Converts a message into an email object, applying templates and extracting metadata.

methods.name: fromTemplate
methods.description: Processes a template string with message data to produce a string.
